question: If 1 is subtracted from each odd digit of the number 6472311, and 2 is added to each even digit, then what will be the sum of the second digit from the left and second digit from the right in the new number thus formed?
solution:
The pattern follows here is:

If 1 is subtracted from each odd digit of the number 6472311, and 2 is added to each even digit to the number we get.
